body: Implement .adlc/specs/codex-native-roadmap.md as the contract. Deliver a publish-ready @adlc/codex plugin; deterministic adlc init plus $adlc-init; current-ticket-driven rail activation; advisory lifecycle continuity hooks; an allowlisted stdio MCP server; project-local reviewer/verifier/explorer agent templates; canonical, cleanup-safe isolated install smoke coverage; pinned and latest Codex CI proofs; executable marketing/docs command checks; and accurate Git marketplace install/update/remove guidance. Correct invalid homepage commands, qualify hook/enforcement claims, remove volatile Codex model assertions, and make advertised umbrella package coverage truthful. Acceptance is AC1-AC9 in the spec. Suppressions are denied. Publishing to npm and mutating user-global ~/.codex state are explicitly out of scope.

edges.contract: T46 implements the Codex subset and executable truth checks; keep T45's all-harness documentation sweep independently grabbable

title: Flush the ADLC through Codex-native install, hooks, MCP, agents, CI, and truthful docs
